question: The cost price of 15 apples is the same as the selling price of 12 apples. Find the percentage profit.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (C.P) × 15 = selling price (S.P) × 12

**Concept used:**

Profit (P) = (S.P - C.P.)

Profit % = (P × 100)/C.P

**Calculation:**

⇒ C.P × 15 = S.P × 12

⇒ C.P/S.P = 12/15 = 4/5

Profit% = {(S.P - C.P.) × 100}/C.P

⇒ (5 - 4) × 100}/4

⇒ (1 × 100)/4 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 2**5%.
